mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_feedback(teacher_id, course_id, session_id, question, original_answer, corrected_answer, rating, comment, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{courseId}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{originalAnswer}, #{correctedAnswer}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update:
UPDATE llm_feedback
corrected_answer = #{correctedAnswer},
rating = #{rating},
comment = #{comment},
status = #{status},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, teacher_id AS teacherId, course_id AS courseId, session_id AS sessionId, question, original_answer AS originalAnswer, corrected_answer AS correctedAnswer, rating, comment, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM llm_feedback WHERE id = #{id}
